verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows let users define automations that are attached to links or auto-attached to new links. They run multi-action steps such as reminders, messages and a 'Send a webhook' action at set times before or after a meeting, and they follow reschedules and cancellations automatically. This covers rules that trigger actions on events, with native event webhooks complementing it. missing for 10: no documented conditional filters or branching logic within workflow rules, no full enumeration of the event triggers workflows can use, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks with SavvyCal workflows
Keep your automations neatly organized with powerful multi-action workflows.
To run your code at a set time before or after a meeting, use a workflow's Send a webhook action.
Reschedule, and the steps still to come move to the new time. Cancel, and they're called off.
Turn on "Automatically attach to new links," and every link you create from then on picks it up.
event.created Emitted when someone schedules a new event via one of your scheduling links
